packages.title: Disclosure meaning and historical availability
packages.failure: A reported consolidated balance is admitted as a legal-book opening; a later document enters an earlier information set.
packages.existing_support: Retained source, statement, network and population histories; recursive source inventories; exact information-time projections.
packages.closure_evidence: For each selected source dependency retain exact bytes, span, edition, precision and availability interval; translate the actual qualification or preserve an unresolved obligation; show admissible, contradicted and unresolved family outcomes.
packages.next_action: Choose the smallest material unresolved contract or population dependency from the existing Apple package, inspect its original span and incorporated reference, and test its actual downstream effect.
packages.limits: Actual legal-book records may remain unidentified; a coherent partial family is acceptable only with the excluded population and consequences visible.

packages.title: Admissible history construction and mappings
packages.failure: Separate marginal alternatives create an impossible company; omitted contracts disappear from a completeness claim.
packages.existing_support: Finite/affine candidate generation, retained joint histories, explicit population overlaps and carried claims.
packages.closure_evidence: Declare template/domain scope, joint constraints, context and population relations; retain all feasible alternatives within that scope or expose search remainder; check negative and outside-scope examples against independent solutions.
packages.next_action: Extend a concrete missing event or non-affine relationship required by W01; do not rebuild existing affine families.
packages.limits: No solver may invent legal findings, disjointness, unknown transactions or probabilities.

packages.title: Information, inference and persistent ambiguity
packages.failure: An uninformative observation deletes a type; replacement evidence is conjoined with the superseded assertion; a policy sees future outcomes.
packages.existing_support: Exact finite filtering/path enumeration, original PMCMC proof note, revision/information runtime fixtures, actor-time contracts and E02 extended-target exchange/correction diagnostics.
packages.closure_evidence: Specify persistent state, actor observation kernels, evidence identity and permitted policy class; compare recursive and path results under informative/uninformative/conflicting/revised evidence; retain unweighted sets when a measure is unjustified.
packages.next_action: After E02, inspect modern waste-free and quantitative/resampling dependencies and define an immutable-vintage inference request; separately bind actor information to multi-period policies.
packages.limits: Company likelihoods, priors and strategic disclosure models require identification; finite exact examples do not establish general inference accuracy.

packages.title: Compression and controlled state growth
packages.failure: Equal cash or means conceal different refinancing rights; a small smooth error changes a default decision.
packages.existing_support: Observation-sensitive finite quotient and finite discrete-action coupling/error derivations with exact checks.
packages.closure_evidence: State query, horizon, policy and observation class; prove exact joint-kernel equivalence or provide computable output-error and feasible-policy-transfer premises; retain detail and invalidate grouping when scope changes.
packages.next_action: Construct one mixed/continuous contract example whose observation and guard margins can be bounded; compare lazy shared-state execution against full enumeration on small instances.
packages.limits: Storage sharing is not semantic merging; sampling is not an exact bound; general worst-case combinatorial complexity remains.

packages.title: Financing settlement and contractual memory
packages.failure: An unfunded payment stops execution and the obligation vanishes from subsequent simulation; late cash rewrites earlier payment status.
packages.existing_support: Dated financing accrual/schedules, limited unpaid-rights examples, one-period quote-policy cases, typed issuance/share memory and E01 complete maturity/partial/late-settlement paths.
packages.closure_evidence: Connect due recognition, partial settlement, missed payment, later recovery and reports in the common typed executor; preserve face, carrying amount, past-due claim, cash, event dates and failed prefixes against an independent complete-state oracle.
packages.next_action: E01 is checked within supplied zero-coupon timing; next expose its reusable claim/share/history invariants and opening admission, then add supported dated funding decisions and rights-changing events.
packages.limits: Synthetic no-fee/no-tax/no-penalty/no-acceleration convention; general default, insolvency and actual accounting admission remain separate.

packages.title: Endogenous debt, equity and control
packages.failure: Lenders price a policy owners abandon; a positive quote cannot be funded; conversion changes control but future decisions use old ownership.
packages.existing_support: Finite price-policy fixed-point enumeration, priority/participation examples, diluted ownership and multi-world EPS methods.
packages.closure_evidence: Specify information and commitment timing, owner liquidity/participation, creditor payoff/priority, dated settlement and post-conversion control; solve multi-period/mixed-policy cases or explicitly establish missing existence/selection premises.
packages.next_action: Add a two-date finite financing decision with an independent exhaustive strategy comparator and a governance-changing conversion case.
packages.limits: Economic share value, accounting equity and regulatory capital differ; no unique equilibrium or bargaining allocation is presumed.

packages.title: Corporate accounting methods and authority
packages.failure: An eligible treatment in one edition is applied to a different issuer or date; zero reversal weights are replaced with arbitrary allocations.
packages.existing_support: Bounded customer, inventory, benefits, assets, leases, tax and statement methods with retained authority limits.
packages.closure_evidence: For each operation retain applicable edition/transition, factual findings, complete formulas and same-fact competing treatments; test original/modified/unsupported cases and consequential journals/reports.
packages.next_action: Resolve zero-weight CGU reversal under a new primary-authority lead; then broader mixed promises, calendars, tax origins and costing according to actual case dependencies.
packages.limits: Balanced journals and author review cannot establish authority or real eligibility; source gaps block only their dependent conclusions.

packages.title: Group, ownership, hedge and currency composition
packages.failure: Consolidated cash funds an inaccessible subsidiary; heterogeneous hedge origins are allocated by nominal fractions; EPS uses an arbitrary world minimum.
packages.existing_support: Native group bindings, conditional group reporting, origin-matched reserve and finite rights examples.
packages.closure_evidence: Preserve legal owners, control dates, transfer constraints, reciprocal identities and tax/FX origins; define arbitrary nonadditive EPS selection or refuse it; exercise an acquisition/hedge/financing composition.
packages.next_action: Choose a retained heterogeneous-origin or nonadditive-EPS counterexample and finish its exact rule and authority analysis before common integration.
packages.limits: A group adjustment must not mutate legal books; valuation and control facts remain supplied findings.

packages.title: Bank credit, funding and regulatory methods
packages.failure: Book write-off erases legal recovery; multiple effective-rate roots are collapsed; a requested funding line is treated as cash.
packages.existing_support: Shared exact credit state, conditional classified cash, finite ECL/POCI/commitment and funding/capital methods.
packages.closure_evidence: Specify floating resets, write-off allocation, root identity, cash classification, settlement and regulatory perimeter; compare full credit states and shared-company statements including adverse cases.
packages.next_action: Extend the exact credit case with an explicit unpaid/right/write-off distinction and a supported multi-root or reset method only when needed.
packages.limits: Actual credit/recovery and operative regulatory findings are not inferred from synthetic cases; calibration remains deferred.

packages.title: Insurance valuation and company interaction
packages.failure: Equal group balances hide cohorts; nonlinear treaty losses use quota formulas; finance and service origins offset incorrectly.
packages.existing_support: Insurance fiscal carry, statement bridge, component identity repair, loss/recovery and finite valuation methods.
packages.closure_evidence: Bind group membership, transition history, FCF/RA/service/finance origins and treaty dependence to exact state/report examples; retain actual actuarial assumptions and separate physical/pricing measures.
packages.next_action: Complete mixed-origin early-termination or changing treaty allocation with a shared-group report comparator; match the published valuation paper and official code.
packages.limits: A finite actuarial law or calendar-year fixture does not establish general valuation or historical admission.

packages.title: General language and compatible rule composition
packages.failure: A command wrapper is mistaken for source-defined validation; flattening joins same-named terms from different claims.
packages.existing_support: Complete method/program authoring, declarative openings/eligibility, Unicode repair, generic nested-map projection, grouped queries and guarded query composition.
packages.closure_evidence: Expose general grouping/cardinality/ordered-selection rules; compare complete typed/source states and refusal behavior with native baselines disabled; specify unsupported constructs and cross-profile migrations.
packages.next_action: Preserve the live nested-query-template plan and its successors; then replace the term invariant only after full obligation mapping and empty/duplicate/ownership/date adversaries pass.
packages.limits: Do not duplicate concurrent nested-query work or promote one receivable grammar to an all-method language.

packages.title: Identity, revision, persistence and recovery
packages.failure: A stale cache survives a source revision; lost acknowledgement repeats a journal; different publication flags are copied between profiles.
packages.existing_support: PublicationEffects/1 compares 1892 retained exchanges; identity successor, local process restart and immutable correction views exist.
packages.closure_evidence: Specify migration and effect ownership across current profiles; prove replay/idempotence under real store transactions, stale views and concurrent writers with recorded fault boundaries.
packages.next_action: Audit concrete migration dependencies and query invalidation; design a bounded store-fault harness before any durability promotion.
packages.limits: Documentary crash worlds and process exits do not establish power-loss durability; production execution stays held.

packages.title: Numerical domains and solver certification
packages.failure: A local root is reported as the unique financing solution; timeout becomes infeasibility; independent interval endpoints make an impossible book.
packages.existing_support: Exact rational/affine and shared algebraic-root credit projections, boundary and residual-objective counterexamples.
packages.closure_evidence: Define each added formula class, rounding and root semantics; return witnesses, certified infeasibility/bounds or unresolved coverage; verify financial outputs and guards against independent exact cases.
packages.next_action: Use the smallest intended mixed-sign or non-affine operation to justify the next numerical fragment; audit learned gradients/objectives before any training.
packages.limits: Residual fit is explanatory unless the target-specific downstream criterion is met; no training authorized by this plan.

packages.title: Matched software and executable adapters
packages.failure: Expected ACTUS fixture arithmetic is called ACTUS execution; package versions or publication semantics do not match.
packages.existing_support: Pinned specs, dictionaries, official code blobs, adapter contracts and independent fixture arithmetic.
packages.closure_evidence: Retain matching release/source/dependencies/licence and execute admitted exchanges with missing-input, calendar and reset cases; identify authentic replication linkage and source-version differences.
packages.next_action: Find new legitimate ACTUS core and Duarte-Fonseca package leads; compare TC-VAE published equations with retained preprint and pinned code.
packages.limits: Unavailable code is an access residual; installations and performance campaigns need their own reviewed environment plan.

packages.title: Primary literature, proof dependencies and competitors
packages.failure: A metadata hit substitutes for technical reading; a theorem is transferred without its policy or topology assumptions.
packages.existing_support: 27-source/claim ledger, backward/forward records, original PMCMC target proof and source-specific edition/access dispositions.
packages.closure_evidence: For every consequential claim retain primary method/theory/appendix anchors and official code where available; fairly reproduce arguments, derive local transfers and record unsatisfied premises; disposition every remaining named competitor.
packages.next_action: Read available Benzoni/Dewatripont and adapted-topology dependencies; pursue Francis-Rowell, Gentry and Strebulaev edition gaps using new leads only.
packages.limits: An access log is not a reading; acquired text is not blocked work; no exhaustive-literature claim follows.

packages.title: Integrated failure and conformance cases
packages.failure: Every module passes while interfaces disagree on event IDs, dates, ownership, information or completeness.
packages.existing_support: Six inherited interaction rows, 67 simulation failures, later literature failures, finite I1/I2 runtime integration and E01 complete settlement paths.
packages.closure_evidence: Map every documented failure to scoped evidence or an executable next test; exercise full original/revised/failed-prefix company paths and independent complete outputs, including unweighted and failed branches.
packages.next_action: Retain checked E01 maturity/settlement composition; next combine information revisions, conversion/control, default/guarantees and compression under explicit contracts.
packages.limits: Unit-test count is not interaction coverage or complete-company admission; add newly discovered failures.

packages.title: Manuscript consistency and implementation acceptance
packages.failure: Hundreds of additive pages leave contradictory main-chapter semantics; local rendered review is called whole-document acceptance.
packages.existing_support: Protected 741-page main and 183-page simulation volume; archive/latest links and scoped integration checks.
packages.closure_evidence: Reconcile definitions and obsolete scope statements across the entire candidate; preserve equations/citations/qualifications; build both volumes, inspect changed and connected rendered pages, then obtain separate reader/domain/independent implementability evidence.
packages.next_action: Maintain companion execution notes now; integrate a coherent checked increment into a new protected successor rather than changing frozen PDFs.
packages.limits: Human feedback is pending acceptance, not a reason to stop internal preparation; no paid engagement is authorized.

packages.title: Target-specific evaluation and production staging
packages.failure: Synthetic correctness or a clean PDF promotes a predictor/default; failed issuers and failed branches disappear from evaluation.
packages.existing_support: Saved E3 target/vintage/baseline/uncertainty protocol and staged master controls.
packages.closure_evidence: Keep S6 held and E3 deferred until their stated prerequisites are supported; later declare actual workload, fair tuned comparator ladder, target-specific training/inference budgets and uncertainty-supported downstream criteria.
packages.next_action: Continue ready design/source/conformance dependencies; do not launch forecasting, paid review or a background campaign.
packages.limits: No default promotion, comparative performance ranking or production-readiness claim is made.

scope: Known gaps and new interface challenges; not exhaustive; no production promotion
